svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Clippo architecture
svg.desc: Brand, creator and admin use a Next.js web app on Vercel with a Postgres database. The app calls an AI verifier, World ID and the YouTube Data API. USDC is escrowed on Arc testnet in ClippoEscrow. A Chainlink CRE workflow reads YouTube view counts and sends a signed report through a forwarder and ClippoReportReceiver to the escrow. The CRE workflow is simulated with the CLI and not deployed, and the receiver is in simulation mode.
svg.text: Brands pay creators in USDC on Arc testnet for verified clip views. An agent proposes, never moves money alone.
CRE: simulated with the CLI, not deployed
World ID: not run against the real portal or issuer
Shows Confirmed beside Pending views, with a proof link.
Two-sided fees go to the treasury
Retention: credits wait 7 days, in tranches
a timeout releases the credits to the creator
claim and claimFor: a payout can only reach the creator
registerHuman, humanOf: only linked wallets are credited
Close after the deadline: unspent pool returns to the brand
Reject or no approval in time: full refund to the brand

g.text: A verdict is only an input.
Each node reads YouTube videos and channels (key = CRE secret)
Keep a clip only if the channel bio holds clippo:<wallet>
Nodes agree on the median view count
Signed report goes to the forwarder
Simulated with the CLI on real Arc

svg.text: Money flow, per-view campaign (numbers match the green arrows)
The fee goes to the treasury.
The AI verdict checks the clip
CRE nodes read YouTube and sign
a report with the median views.
Creator or the Clippo wallet claims.
Pay can only reach the creator.
After the deadline anyone can close.
Unspent pool returns to the brand.
Contracts: Foundry + forge script. Optional ClippoReferral and ClippoCreatorProfile modules are off by default and not drawn.
